summary: Iteration 5 frontend E2E: cinematic intro timing/gating, 'Wow Features' → 'What Morris Offers' rename, and CIS Refund Predictor Info popup + Favourite toggle. Findings: rename PASSES on nav + footer (no 'Wow' anywhere). CIS popup PASSES end-to-end (overlay/popup/tax-notice with rgb(59,130,246) blue border, 🧮 emoji, 'What this tool does' heading, all 3 dismiss methods work, favourite POSTs /api/profile/update + shows 'Added to favourites' toast + star fills #E8A020, toggle-off works + posts again). Smoke: /app/tools/cis-invoice-generator reachable via SPA. ONE CRITICAL BUG FOUND on the cinematic intro: the setTimeout to remove the overlay + set sessionStorage('morris_intro_shown') NEVER fires within 10s — overlay stays in DOM, body.overflow stays 'hidden' (scroll locked), sessionStorage flag never persists, and intro replays on every reload. CSS animations finish (slogan sweep playState='finished' at ct=3000) but the JS timeline does not — root cause is `useEffect(..., [onDone])` in CinematicIntro.jsx restarting timers on every parent render because Landing.jsx defines `dismissIntro` inline (new reference each render). Combined with the SETSTATE chain (Landing's t=setTimeout(setLandingVisible,4500) AND CinematicIntro's t1=setTimeout(setFadingOut,4500) both triggering re-renders that re-create dismissIntro and re-fire the useEffect cleanup → fresh timers → repeat), the 6000ms timer effectively never completes a full cycle uninterrupted. Effect: user is permanently scroll-locked behind a black overlay and the intro replays on every page load. Spec target was ~6s + sessionStorage flag set; in practice this never happens in our 10s test window.

ui_bugs.issue: Intro overlay never removed from DOM, body.overflow stays 'hidden' (page permanently scroll-locked), sessionStorage('morris_intro_shown') never set, intro replays on every reload. CSS keyframes complete normally but the setTimeout(...6000) callback never resolves. Root cause: CinematicIntro's useEffect lists [onDone] as a dep, and Landing.jsx defines `dismissIntro` inline (new function each render). Each state update in Landing (e.g. setLandingVisible at 4500ms) triggers a re-render → new dismissIntro reference → useEffect cleanup clears t1/t2 → effect re-runs with FRESH timers. Net: t2(6000) keeps getting cleared and restarted, never reaching 6000ms uninterrupted before another render restarts it. Verified empirically: after sessionStorage.clear() + reload, waited 10s — overlay still present, overflow='hidden', flag=null.

integration_issues.flow: Direct URL → /app/tools/cis-refund-predictor (and /app/tool/cis-refund-predictor) after fresh login redirects to '/' (Landing). Cause appears to be auth race on full page load — AppShell's auth check transitions through user=null state on hard reload and the protected route guard kicks user to '/' before localStorage.morris_token is read & /api/auth/me resolves. SPA-link navigation works fine (verified). Also the path in the review request '/app/tools/cis-refund-predictor' (plural 'tools') does not match the configured route '/app/tool/cis-refund-predictor' (singular) and redirects to '/app/cis-predictor'. Likely test-environment artifact + minor doc/route mismatch, not a user-facing regression for this iteration's scope.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix CinematicIntro intro never-dismissing. Cheapest fix: drop [onDone] dep → use `useEffect(() => {...}, [])` and call `onDone?.()` inside t2 via a ref, OR wrap dismissIntro in `useCallback(() => {...}, [])` in Landing.jsx. Recommended: useCallback in Landing.jsx (less surface change). Verify: sessionStorage.clear(); reload(); wait 7s → overlay should be gone, body.overflow restored, sessionStorage.morris_intro_shown='1'.
Optional: align documented route '/app/tools/cis-refund-predictor' (plural) with actual route '/app/tool/cis-refund-predictor' or add a redirect alias.
critical_code_review_comments: CinematicIntro.jsx L19-35: `useEffect(() => {...}, [onDone])` — onDone is unstable from parent (Landing.jsx defines dismissIntro inline). Each render of Landing creates a new function reference → cleanup runs → t1/t2 cleared → fresh timers set. Combined with Landing's own setLandingVisible(true) at 4500ms (which renders Landing, which re-creates dismissIntro), the timers never complete a 6000ms run. Fix: empty dep array + ref for onDone, or wrap in useCallback at the caller.

Landing.jsx L26-29: `const dismissIntro = () => { sessionStorage.setItem(...); setShowIntro(false); };` — should be useCallback to keep referential identity stable so CinematicIntro's useEffect doesn't restart.

Landing.jsx L21: `setTimeout(() => setLandingVisible(true), 4500)` — even after the CinematicIntro bug is fixed, this independent timer triggers a Landing re-render at 4500ms which will still bounce CinematicIntro's effect if [onDone] dep stays in place. Confirms the fix must be inside CinematicIntro.

CISRefundPredictor.jsx popup overlay (L84-148): well-implemented — overlay click-outside, stopPropagation on popup, accessible aria-labels on info/fav/close. Tax notice border uses inline `#3B82F6` (rgb(59,130,246)) confirmed in computed styles. 🧮 emoji renders. All 3 testids present and working.

CISRefundPredictor.jsx toggleFav (L22-30): correctly calls api.post('/profile/update', { favourites }) then refresh() to update useAuth context. Toast on success + error branch. Verified end-to-end: star fill toggles #E8A020 ↔ none, 2 POSTs observed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL intro bug: CinematicIntro.jsx useEffect [onDone] dep + Landing.jsx dismissIntro inline = timer restart loop. Spec'd 6s overlay → infinite overlay + permanent scroll lock + sessionStorage flag never set. CSS animations complete fine; only the JS timeline breaks. To retest fix: sessionStorage.clear() in console → reload → within ~7s overlay should fade out and body.style.overflow should be ''. Then reload again — overlay should NOT replay (sessionStorage.morris_intro_shown='1'). CIS Refund Predictor (all 6 testids working) is reachable via SPA link click from /app sidebar 'Recently Used' or 'Finance' section — the link href is '/app/tool/cis-refund-predictor' (singular) and the resolved URL is '/app/cis-predictor'. Direct page.goto to /app/tool* fails with auth redirect to '/' due to hard-reload auth race (not new in iteration 5). All other iteration-5 surfaces (rename in nav+footer, popup heading/body/tax notice blue border/emoji, 3 dismiss paths, favourite toggle with /profile/update POST+toast+gold fill, smoke /app/tools/cis-invoice-generator) verified PASS.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: 1) Open https://prompt-web-4.preview.emergentagent.com/ 2) DevTools → Application → Session Storage → clear → reload. Expected: overlay fades out at ~4.5s, removed at ~6s, sessionStorage.morris_intro_shown='1', body.overflow=''. Actual: overlay stays forever, body.overflow stays 'hidden', flag never set. RCA: CinematicIntro.jsx useEffect dep [onDone] + Landing.jsx inline dismissIntro = cleanup re-runs on every Landing render → t1(4500) and t2(6000) cleared and recreated repeatedly. The Landing.jsx independent setTimeout(setLandingVisible(true), 4500) on L21 guarantees at least one Landing re-render mid-cycle, which clears the freshly-set t2(6000) before it can fire. Mitigation: useCallback dismissIntro in Landing.jsx OR remove [onDone] dep + use a ref inside CinematicIntro.jsx.
